The consecutive listed olshedy qokeedy groups recur across pages at f77r.23 G005-G006 and f85r1.4 G005-G006 in ZL3b/IT2a; RF retains the loci but marks the forms uncertain. It would distinguish only a preregistered rival predicting no recurrence; component versus whole-phrase reuse requires a further test of internal substitutions or role transfer. This is structural evidence, not evidence for any gloss.
